design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses student-level data but does not mention applying any sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual students without using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy beyond the internal analysis of the dataset.
